subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw own Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as an official qwen provider/auth surface, including the canonical id, possible bailian-token-plan alias, and supported region set?
rationale: The request fits the model-provider roadmap, but it adds public provider, auth-choice, env-var, endpoint, catalog, and alias contracts; Alibaba's current docs also create region and alias decisions that automation should not settle alone. ([alibabacloud.com](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/token-plan-overview))

options.title: Accept Bundled Token Plan Provider
options.body: Review and repair the linked PR until the provider, auth choices, docs, generated catalogs, alias decision, and region contract are consistent, then merge it as an official qwen provider.

options.title: Route To External Plugin
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish Token Plan support as an external provider plugin if maintainers do not want to own another bundled Alibaba provider contract.

options.title: Defer For Vendor-Contract Proof
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause landing until maintainers have stronger proof for the CN region and bailian-token-plan compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Bundled Token Plan Provider
recommendation.body: Review and repair the linked PR until the provider, auth choices, docs, generated catalogs, alias decision, and region contract are consistent, then merge it as an official qwen provider.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history-backed owner for the qwen provider surface and bundled-provider product boundary.
